name: azure-devops
description: Azure DevOps integration — query and manage work items (WIQL, create, update), inspect builds and their failing jobs, list pull requests, and run pipelines. Authenticates with an org-scoped Personal Access Token sent as HTTP Basic auth (empty username) against the Azure DevOps REST API v7.1; works with dev.azure.com organizations and on-premises Azure DevOps Server collection URLs.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Azure DevOps work items, builds, pull requests, and pipelines

fields.label: Organization URL
fields.helpText: Your Azure DevOps organization URL, e.g. https://dev.azure.com/acme. On-premises Azure DevOps Server collection URLs also work.

fields.label: Personal Access Token
fields.helpText: An org-scoped Personal Access Token with Work Items (Read & Write), Build (Read & Execute), and Code (Read) scopes. Created under User settings > Personal access tokens.

tools.name: devops.query_work_items
tools.description: Run a WIQL query against a project and return the matching work items (id, type, title, state, assignee; capped at 50).

project.description: Project name or ID to query in

wiql.description: WIQL query, e.g. SELECT [System.Id] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.State] = 'Active'

tools.name: devops.get_work_item
tools.description: Get a single work item with its core fields, description, relations (links/attachments), and most recent comments.

commentLimit.description: Max recent comments to include (default 10, max 50)

tools.name: devops.create_work_item
tools.description: Create a new work item (Bug, Task, User Story, etc.) in a project with title and optional description, assignee, and tags.

project.description: Project name or ID to create the work item in

type.description: Work item type name as defined by the project's process, e.g. Bug, Task, User Story, Feature, Epic

assignedTo.description: Assignee display name, email, or unique name (System.AssignedTo)

tools.name: devops.update_work_item
tools.description: Update an existing work item: change state, reassign, retitle, or set arbitrary fields by reference name.

state.description: New state as defined by the work item type, e.g. Active, Resolved, Closed

assignedTo.description: New assignee display name, email, or unique name

fields.description: Additional fields to set, keyed by reference name (e.g. {"Microsoft.VSTS.Common.Priority": 1})

tools.name: devops.list_builds
tools.description: List recent builds in a project, optionally filtered by status or result (id, build number, definition, status, result, start time, branch).

tools.name: devops.get_build
tools.description: Get a build's details plus its timeline, surfacing failed jobs/stages with their error messages.

tools.name: devops.list_pull_requests
tools.description: List pull requests in a repository, or across all repositories in a project when no repository is given (id, title, author, branches, status).

repository.description: Repository name or ID; omit to list pull requests across the whole project

status.description: Filter by pull request status (default active)

limit.description: Max pull requests to return (default 25, max 100)

tools.name: devops.run_pipeline
tools.description: Queue a run of a YAML/classic pipeline, optionally on a specific branch. This starts real CI/CD jobs which may deploy or change environments.

branch.description: Branch to run against, e.g. main or refs/heads/main (defaults to the pipeline's default branch)
